_about: Persistent research sources. `foundry refresh` runs the ones whose cadence has lapsed, then rebuilds. cmd is argv relative to the Foundry root, run with python3; {domain} expands to each domain for domain 'all'. Runtime state (last run, yield) lives in the data plane, not here.
